gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on an iPhone the Garmin Instinct 3 can't reply to texts at all (Garmin's manual says replies work 'only for compatible Android phones'), or that the Amazfit T-Rex 3 and 3 Pro can't send SMS replies from an iPhone (Zepp says iOS users can reply only to notifications from chat apps, and only through a Beeper account), while Apple now sells the Ultra 4 rather than the Ultra 3 that ChatGPT showed.
standout_why: I compared against mobileplustech.com (cited), which says only that the Apple Watch Ultra 3 'works only with iPhone' and that Garmin, Amazfit and Casio 'generally pair with both'. It never mentions limits on text replies, phone OS versions, satellite exclusions or the Ultra 4. The TechRadar T-Rex 3 Pro review (cited) came back with only its headline, so I couldn't read it; its headline mentions only price. ChatGPT's own answer says just 'For iPhone users… Apple Watch Ultra'. None of these explain that the two cheaper picks pair with an iPhone but can't reply to texts from it.
decides: If the shopper has an iPhone and wants to answer texts from the wrist, the Garmin Instinct 3 is out, because Garmin says replies are Android-only. The Amazfit T-Rex 3 and 3 Pro can reply only to chat apps and only through a third-party Beeper account. That makes the Apple Watch Ultra the pick for iPhone owners, and Apple's current model is the Ultra 4 from $799, not the Ultra 3 on ChatGPT's card. If the shopper uses Android or only needs to read alerts, the Instinct 3 and T-Rex 3 keep their places. The Ultra 4 and fenix 8 Pro satellite features also have stated exclusions (carrier or inReach plan, country limits, Apple's 62° latitude limit) that matter for back-country buyers.

findings.label: Replying to text messages from the watch
findings.value: Android only: 'NOTE: This feature is available only for compatible Android phones.' The phone sends the chosen preset reply as an SMS.
findings.source_title: Instinct 3 Solar Owner's Manual: Replying to a Text Message (Garmin)
findings.note: This is Garmin's own owner's manual for the Instinct 3 Solar, in its APAC English edition. A search also returned an Instinct 3 AMOLED Series manual page with the same title, which I didn't open. That search's summary said that page carries the same Android-only note, but I couldn't confirm it.

findings.label: Pairing requirement
findings.value: Phone features work only after pairing through the Garmin Connect app. The manual's Phone Connectivity Features page lists no minimum phone OS.
findings.source_title: Instinct 3 Solar Series Owner's Manual: Phone Connectivity Features (Garmin, EN-US)

findings.label: Minimum phone OS
findings.value: Android 7.0 or later, or iOS 15.0 or later, set up in the Zepp app
findings.source_title: Amazfit T-Rex 3 Pro support manual: Connection and pairing (Amazfit US support)
findings.note: Quote: 'Your mobile phone must run Android 7.0 or iOS 15.0 or later.' The same manual says the Camera Remote 'is not currently supported on Android devices', and that on iOS only a limited set of apps can be added to App alerts right after activation.

findings.label: Replying to messages, Android vs iOS (Zepp OS 5)
findings.value: On Android the watch can send SMS through Zepp Flow once Zepp Messenger is turned on, though Zepp says 'Availability may vary depending on your Android phone model and software version.' On iOS it can only reply to notifications from chat apps, and 'iOS notification replies require a valid Beeper account with connected chat apps.'
findings.note: The same page lists both the T-Rex 3 and the T-Rex 3 Pro as Zepp OS 5 watches.

findings.label: Interactive iOS notifications (replies and actions)
findings.value: The beta launched on the Cheetah 2 Ultra, Balance Ultra and Balance 3. The T-Rex 3 and T-Rex 3 Pro are listed as 'planned later' with no date. The feature is EU-only for now.
findings.source_title: More than just notifications: Amazfit smartwatches now interact with iOS (Notebookcheck, Silvio Werner)
findings.note: Published 2026-07-28 and updated 2026-10-05. Notebookcheck links the EU-only rollout to Apple's Digital Markets Act obligations and says a worldwide release 'remains uncertain'.

findings.label: Current generation and US price on Apple's store
findings.value: Apple's store sells the Ultra 4 'From $799'. Every listed configuration is GPS + Cellular.
findings.source_title: Shop Apple Watch Ultra 4 (Apple Store US)
findings.note: ChatGPT's card showed the Apple Watch Ultra 3. Apple's US store now lists only the Ultra 4.

findings.label: Phone compatibility
findings.value: Needs an iPhone 11 or later, including the iPhone SE (2nd generation or later), running iOS 27 or later. Apple lists no Android support.
findings.note: The same page lists the in-box cable as 'Apple Watch Magnetic Fast Charger to USB-C Cable (1m)' and gives 'Up to 80% charge in about 45 minutes'.

findings.label: Satellite feature limits
findings.value: Find My and Messages via satellite require a carrier plan. Emergency SOS via satellite is free for 2 years after activation. Satellite connectivity 'might not work in places above 62° latitude'. It isn't offered on watches bought in Armenia, Belarus, mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan or Russia. It isn't available on the watch while a nearby iPhone is in Airplane mode.
findings.source_title: Apple Support 123924: Use satellite features on Apple Watch Ultra
findings.note: Apple says 'With Apple Watch Ultra 3 and later, you can connect your watch to a satellite' and that availability 'depends on your country or region'.

findings.label: LTE and satellite messaging requirement
findings.value: An active inReach subscription is required. Messaging uses the Garmin Messenger app on a compatible smartphone. Garmin's footnote: 'LTE network coverage and satellite connectivity are not available in all countries.'
findings.note: The US version of this page (garmin.com/en-US/connectivity/fenix8pro/feature-requirements) loaded with only its title and navigation, no body text, so I used Garmin's UAE page. The UAE page describes satellite coverage as the continental U.S., parts of Canada and most of Europe.
